rows.note: Use this when something is performed or recorded with acoustic rather than electronic instruments.

example.english: This song was recorded acoustically with acoustic instruments, so it sounds especially nice.
example.traditional: 呢首歌係用原聲樂器錄音，聽落特別有味道。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 hai6 jung6 jyun4 sing1 ngok6 hei3 luk6 jam1 teng1 lok6 dak6 bit6 jau5 mei6 dou6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when discussing something from an acoustics or sound perspective rather than specifically naming an instrument.

example.english: Acoustically, this recording studio is very well designed.
example.traditional: 聲學上，呢間錄音室嘅設計非常完善。
example.jyutping: sing1 hok6 soeng6 ne1 gaan1 luk6 jam1 sat1 ge3 cit3 gai3 fei1 soeng4 jyun4 sin6
